mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q01.stem: Every metal salt can be handled like table salt.
reasons: True is incorrect. Metal salts are not guaranteed the same safety as table salt.
False is correct. Metal salts are not guaranteed the same safety as table salt.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q02.stem: A plating tank can be treated as a constant ideal resistor under every condition.
reasons: True is incorrect. Electrode reactions, contacts and liquid conditions also change in the tank.
False is correct. Electrode reactions, contacts and liquid conditions also change in the tank.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q03.stem: Watching OJT alone is not permission to work independently.
reasons: True is correct. Work scope, skill checks and permission for independent responsibility are separately needed.
False is inappropriate. Work scope, skill checks and permission for independent responsibility are separately needed.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q04.stem: Check the valid edition and scope even when a standard number matches.
reasons: True is correct. Revisions or scope differences can change conditions.
False is inappropriate. Revisions or scope differences can change conditions.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q05.stem: A correct calculation automatically authorizes additions to a production tank.
reasons: True is incorrect. Actual tank operation requires approval separate from calculation correctness.
False is correct. Actual tank operation requires approval separate from calculation correctness.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q06.stem: Weak odor does not prove that harmful gases are absent.
reasons: True is correct. Smell alone cannot assess harmful constituents.
False is inappropriate. Smell alone cannot assess harmful constituents.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q07.stem: Ammeters and voltmeters differ in quantity and connection purpose.
reasons: True is correct. Current flows along a path; voltage is a difference between two points.
False is inappropriate. Current flows along a path; voltage is a difference between two points.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q08.stem: An operator may independently authorize shipment of a small blister.
reasons: True is incorrect. Shipping decisions follow required authority and criteria, not defect size alone.
False is correct. Shipping decisions follow required authority and criteria, not defect size alone.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q09.stem: A 4M change is a candidate cause, not proof by itself.
reasons: True is correct. Changes occurring at the same time do not alone prove causation.
False is inappropriate. Changes occurring at the same time do not alone prove causation.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q10.stem: Check recesses and internal residual liquid before immersion too.
reasons: True is correct. Internal liquid can vaporize and cause splashing in a hot bath.
False is inappropriate. Internal liquid can vaporize and cause splashing in a hot bath.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q11.stem: Processes without external current need no chemical-reaction-condition controls.
reasons: True is incorrect. External current and the need to control chemical conditions are separate.
False is correct. External current and the need to control chemical conditions are separate.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q12.stem: Specified checks are needed even if no oil is visible after degreasing.
reasons: True is correct. No visible oil alone does not guarantee adequate degreasing.
False is inappropriate. No visible oil alone does not guarantee adequate degreasing.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q13.stem: Tracing a calculation also requires standard-solution concentration and sample amount.
reasons: True is correct. Concentration calculation needs standard amount of substance and sample volume.
False is inappropriate. Concentration calculation needs standard amount of substance and sample volume.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q14.stem: Mixing another solution to increase collection is always a safe 3 R activity.
reasons: True is incorrect. Unconfirmed mixing can create hazardous reactions or unsuitable treatment.
False is correct. Unconfirmed mixing can create hazardous reactions or unsuitable treatment.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q15.stem: Defect counts alone prove rate improvement even when production quantities differ.
reasons: True is incorrect. With different denominators, reduced counts and improved rates are different.
False is correct. With different denominators, reduced counts and improved rates are different.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q16.stem: Use 0.80 in calculations for 80% current efficiency.
reasons: True is correct. A percentage of 80% is divided by 100 to give 0.80.
False is inappropriate. A percentage of 80% is divided by 100 to give 0.80.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q17.stem: The word neutralization permits free chemical additions to an actual tank.
reasons: True is incorrect. Neutralization can generate heat and splashing and needs approved procedures.
False is correct. Neutralization can generate heat and splashing and needs approved procedures.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q18.stem: Recheck training scope and authority when work changes.
reasons: True is correct. Confirm whether previous experience and training fit the changed conditions.
False is inappropriate. Confirm whether previous experience and training fit the changed conditions.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q19.stem: Every anodized product can be processed under identical bath conditions.
reasons: True is incorrect. Conditions must match alloy, quality requirements and equipment.
False is correct. Conditions must match alloy, quality requirements and equipment.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q20.stem: Times from different salt-spray methods cannot directly establish superiority.
reasons: True is correct. Tests with different solutions and loads cannot have their times directly equated.
False is inappropriate. Tests with different solutions and loads cannot have their times directly equated.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q21.stem: An accident-free day means no residual risk exists.
reasons: True is incorrect. No accident alone does not prove that hazards are absent.
False is correct. No accident alone does not prove that hazards are absent.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q22.stem: A circular economy has no relation to design or repair.
reasons: True is incorrect. A circular economy also considers design, repair and reuse.
False is correct. A circular economy also considers design, repair and reuse.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q23.stem: Check units and assumptions when calculation and measurement disagree.
reasons: True is correct. First investigate equation applicability and unit errors.
False is inappropriate. First investigate equation applicability and unit errors.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q24.stem: Record the inspected population when comparing defect counts.
reasons: True is correct. A defect rate needs both defects and the total target population.
False is inappropriate. A defect rate needs both defects and the total target population.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q25.stem: Read every hydrometer at the same liquid-surface position regardless of instrument.
reasons: True is incorrect. Check the reading position specified for the instrument and method.
False is correct. Check the reading position specified for the instrument and method.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q26.stem: Every metal product can use the same thickness-gauge principle.
reasons: True is incorrect. Applicable methods vary with material, shape and layer structure.
False is correct. Applicable methods vary with material, shape and layer structure.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q27.stem: A white precipitate alone cannot identify the compound.
reasons: True is correct. Different compounds can form similar white solids.
False is inappropriate. Different compounds can form similar white solids.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q28.stem: Moving waste to a collection box proves less waste was generated.
reasons: True is incorrect. Transfer to collection and reduced generation are separate achievements.
False is correct. Transfer to collection and reduced generation are separate achievements.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q29.stem: Hot-dip plating uses a bath of molten metal.
reasons: True is correct. Immersion in molten metal differs from deposition in an electrolyte.
False is inappropriate. Immersion in molten metal differs from deposition in an electrolyte.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-theory-q30.stem: An abnormal sound must not be reported until its cause is known.
reasons: True is incorrect. Observed facts can be reported before the cause is established.
False is correct. Observed facts can be reported before the cause is established.
